headline: Initial budget request, public comment policy, and a monitoring report on rigorous academic achievement.
summary: Students will give a representative report, and the superintendent will present the initial budget request. Discussion covers public comment rules and executive limitations, and a vote is set on Monitoring Report 1.1.
items: Closed executive session on personnel, legal advice, labor negotiations, and real estate
Public comment and participation policy, executive limitations update, and superintendent feedback on process
Monitoring Report 1.1, Rigorous Academic Achievement (Nicole Carter)
Consent agenda and planning, including setting the December 16, 2026 agenda and reviewing future agenda items
